title: Tensor-power sections pull back with inverse-image nonvanishing locus
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], $n>0$ an integer, and $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$. There exists $t\in\Gamma(Y,(g^*\mathcal L)^{\otimes n})$ such that $Y_t=g^{-1}(X_s)$, where $g^*$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and the nonvanishing loci use the germ-outside-maximal-ideal predicate of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. No affineness, quasi-compactness, or ampleness assumption is imposed.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0892 (morphisms-lemma-pullback-ample-tensor-relatively-ample), proof, equality f^{-1}(Y_t) = X_{f^*t}; tensor comparison is Modules Lemma Tag 01CD (lemma-tensor-product-pullback), and invertibility of powers is Modules Lemma Tag 01CT

proof.text: Choose the canonical adjunction of tensorPullback to pushforward from [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], whose unit is fixed sectionwise by its tensor formula. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives an isomorphism to the usual pullback. Apply the proved source theorem nonempty_pullback_tensorPow_iso (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.ProjectionFormula) and inductively tensor the inverse comparison on L to identify tensorPullback(L.tensorPow n) with (tensorPullback(L)).tensorPow n. The proved source instance IsInvertible.tensorPow supplies invertibility of L.tensorPow n. Apply the chosen adjunction unit to s and transport its section by this isomorphism.

An isomorphism of modules induces mutually inverse linear maps on stalks; each preserves the maximal ideal times the whole stalk, so it preserves nonvanishing. Apply [lem-sc-nonvanishing-tensor-pullback] to the canonical pulled-back section of L.tensorPow n, pointwise at y, to obtain the claimed inverse-image equality.

proof_origin.place: Lean proof by transport through the usual pullback tensor-power comparison, reducing pointwise nonvanishing to lem-sc-nonvanishing-tensor-pullback
